entries.zh: 禁止；不许（原稿汉字作「莫乞」，字面为「不要乞求」，此处用作禁戒语）
entries.en: to prohibit; to forbid (literally "do not beg", used as a prohibition)
entries.notes: R 栏空缺，H 栏「莫乞」与 prohibir 只在大意上相合；M 栏末字带 T99 污损。

entries.zh: 禁止；下令（原稿以「禁止」兼举禁制与命令二义）
entries.en: to forbid, to prohibit; to order, to command

entries.zh: 收养（螟蛉，即收他人之子为己子；「螟」为「螟蛉」之省）
entries.en: to adopt (a child), to take another's son as one's own (from 螟蛉, the classical image of adoption)
entries.notes: L 栏自带「[疑]」标注，H 栏仅「螟」一字，R 栏残损；义据「螟蛉」典补足。

entries.zh: 收养；认契（「契」指契子、义子，即认他人之子为契子）
entries.en: to adopt; to take as a godchild or adopted son (khè-kiáⁿ)
entries.notes: M 栏音写带「[疑:guey/quey]」，只能断定首音近 kè/khè；H 栏「契」为闽南「契子」之省。

entries.zh: 养育；收养（养他人之子为己子）
entries.en: to raise, to bring up; to adopt and rear
entries.notes: M 栏后半音写（c'mauiq）残损难辨，释义据 H 栏「養」与 L 栏 prohijar。

entries.en: adopted son (螟蛉, the classical metaphor for an adopted child)
entries.notes: M 栏「beng leng」之后混入残乱音写（un)uysam abro;），疑为旁注或拉丁文残字，未据以定义。

entries.zh: 过房（无子者收养兄弟之子以承宗祧）
entries.en: to adopt a child into a childless household (kuè-pâng: transferring a son to another branch to continue the family line)

entries.zh: 啰嗦的；说话絮烦惹厌的
entries.en: long-winded and tiresome in conversation; tedious, importunate in talk
entries.notes: M 栏整栏空残、H 栏「咀渦澈」罕见难解，释义仅据 L 栏 prolijo, importuno en la plática，未获四栏互证。

entries.zh: 序言；卷首的序（「头序」为闽南语说法）
延长、加长（房屋、道路等），即「使长」；深长辽远
entries.en: to lengthen, to extend (a house, a road, etc.), i.e. to make long; far-reaching
to consent, to agree; to promise
entries.notes: M 栏带「[疑:on/un]」标注，首音未能定读；义据 H 栏「允」与 L 栏 prometer。

entries.en: to promise; to pledge one's word (lo̍k)

entries.zh: 许诺；应允（原稿并列「諾」「許諾」「允諾」等说法）
entries.en: to promise; to pledge (lo̍k; hú-lo̍k; ún-lo̍k — several current variants)
entries.notes: M 栏为多种近义说的连写，末段（in lo:idg）污损难辨，只取可辨部分对读。
词头 prometer 意为许诺，但 H 栏作「下頭」（下方）、M 栏 e juan 亦不相应，疑错行或残抄，故不裁定义项。
